gui.botaniabackpack.mana_tank.interactio: Right-click with a mana item to transfer; direction follows the transfer mode
gui.botaniabackpack.status.add.mana_infu: Only one Mana Infusion Upgrade can be installed in a backpack.
gui.botaniabackpack.status.add.mana_supp: Only one Mana Supply Upgrade can be installed in a backpack.
gui.botaniabackpack.status.add.mana_tank: Only one Mana Tank Upgrade can be installed in a backpack.
item.botaniabackpack.advanced_mana_infus:
Uses the Mana Tank in the same backpack for mana infusion.
An Alchemy or Conjuration Catalyst below a placed backpack enables its recipes.
Has more filtering options.
item.botaniabackpack.mana_infusion_upgra:
Uses the Mana Tank in the same backpack to transform filtered items with mana-infusion recipes.
Only recipes without a catalyst are supported.
item.botaniabackpack.mana_supply_upgrade:
Allows compatible mana-consuming equipment carried by the player to draw from the Mana Tank in the same backpack on demand.
Does not automatically charge items stored inside the backpack.
item.botaniabackpack.mana_tank_upgrade.t:
Stores mana while the backpack is placed.
Acts as a Botania mana pool for bursts, spreaders, sparks, and mana consumers.
